lines.zh: 我离地飘着，几乎不迈步。
lines.en: I float above the ground, barely stepping.

lines.zh: 我的白色长袍在风里展开。
lines.en: My white robe spreads in the wind.
My wings beat slowly.
I pass over the plains.

lines.zh: 我落在草地上，收拢羽翼。
lines.en: I land on the grass and fold my wings.
I go step by step, rarely planting my feet.
My long spear stays at my side.

lines.zh: 我沿着牧场边的小路走。
lines.en: I follow a path along the pasture.

lines.zh: 我掠过牧场，影子淡得看不见
lines.en: I drift over the pasture, shadow barely there.
I float up to look around.
I turn, and my wings block the light.

lines.zh: 我从树顶上方慢慢过去。
lines.en: I pass slowly above the treetops.
I stand, light running over my shoulders.
My wings hardly move.
I listen to the whispers in the woods.
My robe hangs still.
I plant the spear beside me.
My gaze is calm.
I close my eyes and hear wind through my robe.
The dark aura hasn't cleared, I'll wait.
There isn't a speck on me.
The wind lifts the feathers on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我望着云层里的那道光
lines.en: I look toward the light in the clouds.
I have no road I must hurry along.
There's a ring of light along my wings.

lines.zh: 这条小路我守了很多年
lines.en: I've kept this path for many years.
There's an evil scent on you.
I lower my hand, spear point at the ground.
I keep watch over this ground.
Where are you going?

lines.zh: 我的枪不是为你准备的。
lines.en: My spear isn't meant for you.
One more step closer is fine.
Your partner is here too.

lines.zh: 这条路上常有东西出没。
lines.en: Things often come out on this road.
I see your wounds.
Stand still a moment.
I don't care for conflict.
I know that kind of dark aura.
I'm right above you.
You need not be on guard with me.
There's an echo of prayer in the wind.
I'm doing no more than standing here.
I didn't fall back far.

lines.zh: 光把那道裂口替我合上
lines.en: The light closes that split for me.
My wings caught part of it.
The light on me dimmed for an instant.
I straighten up inch by inch.
I kept it outside me.
The wound faded quickly.
I'm still watching it.
I make no complaint.
I spread my wings and straighten up again.

lines.zh: 这种食物用不到我身上。
lines.en: Such food is not for me.
Keep these things.

lines.zh: 这些供物对我毫无用处
lines.en: These offerings are of no use to me.
That isn't what sustains me.
Holding that up tires you.
Put it down and step back two paces.
I don't eat the food of this world.
Take this offering back with you.
Don't waste your efforts.
We need not trade.

lines.zh: 这些留在你那里更有用。
lines.en: These are more use where you are.
Give it to someone who needs it.
You bump me; I give a little.
My wingspread is wide here.
You nearly touched my spear.
I gather my robe aside.

lines.zh: 我们之间有一点距离就好。
lines.en: A little distance between us is best.
My hem brushed your hand.
There was no hostility in that.
You raised a gust as you stepped back.
One beat of my wings and I rise half a foot.
We're both being courteous.
There are others of my kind below.
We seldom gather in one place.
I can see their light.
We each guard a stretch of road.
It flies higher than I do.
Two shadows come together.
I didn't call it.
It glanced my way.
We parted ways again.
Nothing more is needed.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，把落下的拣起来
lines.en: I bend and pick up what fell.
This can still serve a purpose.
I shake the soil off it.

lines.zh: 它轻得不像这个世界的东西
lines.en: It's lighter than anything of this world.
I shall keep it, then.
I ground my spear point and set it down.
What falls needn't go to waste.
This carries an old smell.
I set it back down.
I've nothing else to take.
That dark aura is moving.
I've raised my spear.
That isn't a person.
I settle downward a little.
My wings have opened.
It's directly in front of me.
I'm keeping it off the road.
I won't hold back this time.
I gather light at the spear's tip.
It's retreating into the shade.
Get back below the stone steps.
In the name of justice.
I stay on it without letting go.
It's hidden in the tree shadow.
My wings of light hold me over its head.
My light will find it.

lines.zh: 我把距离保持在射程内。
lines.en: I keep it within reach.
The wind brings its scent up to me.
I haven't sped up, and needn't.
My spear tip stays leveled.
It's trying to get behind the trees.
I've taken that side already.
Its movements have slowed.
A little closer and it ends.
I sweep the spear across.
The light drives it back.
That strike was a warning.
I didn't hit anything vital.
I descend, wings spread.
It blocked one strike.
That one carried light.
The light shoves it back a long way.
I don't mean to chase far.
I draw the spear back.
Its dark aura has weakened.
I press down again.
The holy light parts and I touch the grass.
My wings open here.
The wind gathers toward me.
The grass blades stand still in the light.
First I looked all around.
I brought nothing with me.
My spear is as it always was.
Someone has to keep this road.
I settle slowly to the ground.

lines.zh: 远处的黑气我感觉得到。
lines.en: I can sense dark aura far off.
All is ready with me.
I lift my eyes and my wings open.
Fire slides off the edge of my robe.
I never truly fell.

lines.zh: 水浸到我，光把它推开了。
lines.en: Water reaches me; the light pushes it away.

lines.zh: 爆炸把周围的草吹平了。
lines.en: The blast flattens the grass around me.
The arrow's tip veers in the light.
That art can hold me for a moment.
I do not live on such things.

lines.zh: 雷打在我上方，我抬起枪。
lines.en: Lightning strikes above; I raise the spear.
There's no light here, and I remain.
